New endpoint serves the per-request JARM ephemeral public JWKS; request objects now reference it by URL instead of the verifier's public key set.
Password policy failures (too short, too similar to identifier, too many breaches) now yield dedicated validation message IDs/texts.
Flow operations and generic uiText (id, text, type) are described; specific password-policy message IDs are not listed.
Version/source info responses gain an annotationSourcesInfo list with id, name, version, type, description, url.
No checked-in contract document; new response field on aggregate source info.
Permission computation for Entra ID users is synchronized, so parent-group permissions are no longer lost to a race, affecting access-filtered results.
Internal race fix; contract does not describe group/permission computation for search results.
Contract sync skips partner entitlements lacking purchase data (and tolerates missing contracts) instead of failing.
Sync operations documented with success response only; handling of malformed upstream entitlements not stated.
Importing passkey credentials without a user_handle or without credentials is now rejected with 400.
Passkey import config lists user_handle and credentials but marks neither required; no rejection rule stated.
Flag snapshot listing applies a configured default limit when no limit parameter is given.
Iceberg schemas whose fields use the initial column ID are no longer rejected as duplicate field IDs.
Only document has paths: {} (inferred from annotations); no Iceberg REST operations described.
Deleted or timed-out consumers are deregistered via the endpoint close handler, with inactivity timestamps cleaned up consistently.
Mostly a concurrency fix; contract does not describe consumer deregistration timing or inactivity timeout.
Process update now pre-fills config with current values, so omitted fields keep existing values; unknown IDs return 404 before body parsing.
Contract states replace semantics; update now merges omitted fields from the current config.
